missions.name: LEARN THE NIGHT
missions.subtitle: HEADLIGHTS & SAFE SPEED
missions.objective: Turn headlights ON [H], keep speed under 40 km/h, and stay centered in your lane.

missions.name: SEE AND REACT
missions.subtitle: PEDESTRIANS AT NIGHT
missions.objective: Pedestrians crossing ahead in dark clothing! Switch to High Beam [F] if needed, slow down, and yield safely.

missions.name: HEADLIGHT DISCIPLINE
missions.subtitle: DIP YOUR LIGHTS
missions.objective: Oncoming traffic approaching! Switch High Beam to Low Beam [F] to avoid blinding oncoming drivers.

missions.name: NIGHT CITY DRIVE
missions.subtitle: URBAN HAZARDS & EMERGENCY
missions.objective: Navigate illuminated avenue. Obey 20 km/h school zone, stop at red light, and yield to ambulance.

missions.name: RAINY NIGHT
missions.subtitle: LOW VISIBILITY & WET ROADS
missions.objective: Heavy rain has reduced visibility to 50%! Braking distances double. Drive with caution to the finish line.
